latest.title: On the Mahler measure and root distribution of the $Q$-polynomial of links
latest.abstract: We study the roots and the Mahler measure of the $Q$-polynomial of links. We first consider links obtained by adding twists to a pair of parallel strands. We prove that the Mahler measure of the transformed $Q$-polynomial converges as the number of twists increases. We also show that all but a uniformly bounded number of distinct roots of the $Q$-polynomial approach the real interval $[-2,2]$. This behavior is different from that of the roots of the Jones polynomial under twisting. Numerical experiments on prime knots lead us to a conjecture about the roots of the transformed $Q$-polynomial of alternating knots. Finally, we compare real and unit-circle roots of the Alexander, Jones, and $Q$-polynomials, and give an infinite family of $2$-bridge links whose $Q$-polynomials have only real nonzero roots.

latest.workSummary: 证明沿平行股加扭后变换 Q-多项式的 Mahler 测度收敛，且除一致有界数量外的不同根趋向实区间 [-2,2]。
latest.breakthrough: 揭示 Q-多项式与 Jones 多项式加扭根行为的差异，并给出非零根全实的二桥链环族。
latest.limitations: 关于交错结根分布的进一步断言仍为数值启发的猜想，不应与已证部分混同。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。 研究结论仅作摘要级分析，未独立核验证明。
latest.priorityReason: 结不变量渐近性质明确，但适用加扭族及多项式较专门。
